user.title: Timercard
user.description: Add Timercard? After this, add the "Timercard" card to a dashboard to create your timers.

create_entry.default: Timercard is ready. Now refresh your browser (Ctrl+F5, or Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac). In the Home Assistant app: Settings → Companion app → Debugging → Reset frontend cache. Then edit a dashboard, choose Add card and search for "Timercard".
